sources.content:
Technician Ivo: In trial P-14, Luma produced fewer warped QL-7 brackets than Sora only with dried feedstock, a closed enclosure and ambient temperature 20-24 C. This is a conditional judgment about warping, not a strength guarantee. Reviewer Nia accepted this limited conclusion. A retelling of P-14 is not an independent trial. Independent trial P-22 used new samples and operator Ada under the same conditions and also favored Luma for warping.
Technician Kez: Sora is usually easier to clean; this is my attributed opinion, not an adopted lab recommendation. QL-7 parts took about 42-58 minutes in profile Z with 0.4 mm nozzle. Trial P-31 failed, but humidity was not measured and the cause is unknown. Lesson: record moisture and actual enclosure before transferring the warping judgment.
